title: Machine learning identifies metabolic signatures associated with ER-positive breast-cancer disparities
summary: Untargeted plasma metabolomics and feature-selection/classification analyses identified group-associated metabolic signatures in ER-positive breast-cancer cases; selected pathway associations were examined in TCGA data. These observational associations do not establish causal drivers of racial disparities.
ai_technology: Boruta and recursive feature selection with random-forest classification identified group-associated metabolite signatures for downstream pathway analysis.
organization: Division of Nutritional Sciences, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Urbana, IL, USA

evidence.tested: Pretreatment metabolomics from 102 ER-positive breast-cancer cases and 148 controls supported group-associated signatures; selected associations were examined in TCGA cases.
evidence.unknown: The retrospective observational analyses do not establish causal mechanisms or explain individual outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Feature selection and random-forest classification identified group-associated plasma-metabolite signatures and prioritized pathway analyses.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text review as recorded in case evidence; record-level claim and attribution review.
